task.text: Come up with a Boruto scene which takes place 10 years later, where Boruto and Sarada are married and have three children, Sarada is the Hokage and Boruto is her Supporting Hokage

attempts.high: I want a Boruto scene set 10 years down the line. The premise: Boruto and Sarada are married with three kids, Sarada's the Hokage and Boruto's her Supporting Hokage. Beyond that it's your call — invent the kids, the mood, what's happening, whatever moment you think captures them best. Surprise me with the scene.
attempts.low: Write a Boruto scene set 10 years later using these exact details: Boruto and Sarada are married with three children (a 9-year-old daughter named Hana, a 6-year-old son named Kenji, twins age 3 named Aoi and Riku). Sarada is the Hokage, Boruto is her Supporting Hokage. The scene takes place at breakfast in their home, lasts one morning, and ends with Sarada leaving for the Hokage office. Use only these elements, add no other characters or plot.
